question: Which of the following is an autobiography of the famous cricketer Sourav Ganguly?

options.text: Memories of My Life and Times

solution:
The correct answer is **A Century is not enough**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"A Century is not enough"** is an autobiography by Sourav Ganguly, one of India's most successful cricket captains.
 
• This book provides a deep insight into his cricket career, leadership, and personal life.
 
• It covers his journey from a young cricketer to becoming the captain of the Indian cricket team.
 
• The book also highlights his challenges, achievements, and the controversies he faced during his career.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 **"A Shot at History"** is an autobiography of Abhinav Bindra, India's Olympic gold medal-winning shooter.
 
 

 Option 2
 **"The Dream of Revolution"** is not related to any famous cricketer's autobiography and is a different genre of literature.
 
 

 Option 3
 **"A Century is not enough"** is the autobiography of Sourav Ganguly, detailing his cricket career and personal experiences.
 
 

 Option 4
 **"Memories of My Life and Times"** is not a known autobiography of any famous cricketer and likely belongs to a different context.
